# Aether-X Port Congestion Oracle

> Predictive port congestion signals for global trade, supply chain and quantitative finance. REST API, Python SDK and MCP server. Returns congestion score, ETA delay, waiting vessels, freight volatility, daily demurrage estimate and 24/48/72h congestion trends for 16 global ports.

## API

- [OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec](https://aether-x-oracle-production.up.railway.app/openapi.rapidapi.json): machine-readable contract (RapidAPI-compatible)
- [Example call](https://aether-x-oracle-production.up.railway.app/v1/port-risk?port_id=BRSSZ): GET /v1/port-risk?port_id=BRSSZ
- [Trend example](https://aether-x-oracle-production.up.railway.app/v1/port-trend?port_id=BRSSZ): GET /v1/port-trend?port_id=BRSSZ
- [Batch example](https://aether-x-oracle-production.up.railway.app/v1/ports-risk?port_ids=BRSSZ,CNSHA,NLRTM): GET /v1/ports-risk?port_ids=BRSSZ,CNSHA,NLRTM
- [Interactive docs](https://aether-x-oracle-production.up.railway.app/docs): Swagger UI
- [RapidAPI marketplace](https://rapidapi.com/belegante/api/aether-x-port-congestion-oracle): metered plans (Free / Pro / Ultra / Mega)
- [Terms of Service](https://aether-x-oracle-production.up.railway.app/terms)

## SDKs and integrations

- [Python SDK (PyPI)](https://pypi.org/project/aetherx-oracle/): `pip install aetherx-oracle` — sync + async client
- [MCP server (PyPI)](https://pypi.org/project/aetherx-mcp/): `uvx aetherx-mcp` — gives AI agents the `get_port_risk`, `get_ports_risk` and `get_port_trend` tools
- [Remote MCP endpoint](https://aether-x-oracle-production.up.railway.app/mcp): Streamable HTTP, no install
- [Smithery gateway](https://smithery.ai/servers/belegante/aetherx-mcp): hosted MCP connection
- [Source (GitHub, MIT)](https://github.com/belegante-byte/aetherx-oracle)

- Official MCP Registry: `io.github.belegante-byte/aetherx-mcp` v0.2.1 (live) — install via `uvx aetherx-mcp` or remote `https://aether-x-oracle-production.up.railway.app/mcp`.

## Dataset

- [Aether-X Global Port Congestion Snapshot (Hugging Face)](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Aether-x/aetherx-port-congestion-metrics): frozen 16-port CSV, CC BY 4.0

## Writing

- [Predicting Global Port Congestion in Real-Time with Python, DuckDB and MCP](https://dev.to/giovanni_belegante_2b04c5/predicting-global-port-congestion-in-real-time-with-python-duckdb-and-mcp-1ahm): DEV Community

## Supported ports

AEDXB, BRRIO, BRSSZ, CNNGB, CNSHA, CNTAO, DEHAM, GBLGP, KRPUS, MPTNG, MXZLO, NLRTM, SGSIN, USLAX, USNYC, ZACPT

Unknown ports fall back to a global statistical estimate (`country="Global"`).

## Notes

- Signals are provided "AS IS" and do not constitute investment advice.
- Metered access is available through the RapidAPI gateway (X-RapidAPI-Key).
